P1.pass: All declared ample pairs match; one mismatch fails.

P2.partial_rule: whole step energy on first paid time unit, once, no refund
P2.pass: Every applicable raw transaction reconstructs; all tamper controls rejected.

P3.pass: At least one preregistered matched population stops at a different paid boundary and independent charge reconstruction identifies the unaffordable next energy admission or exhausted time.
P3.none: not tested/not testable, never pass; no wallet tuning after observations

automatic.controls: 32 withheld-choice cases per model; comparison paid, missing native child rejected

phase5_core.funding_scope: from initial creation including fixture setup; setup exhaustion is retained and reported, not silently replenished

phase5_extensions.scope: Retain all 32 approved sustained histories. Tight setup failure is a recorded outcome. Existing raw Phase5.3-5.6 histories also independently receive conditioning observations.

conditioning.raw_scope: All saved engine/population histories under evidence/FB5.1 through FB5.6, including failed and interrupted histories labeled separately; deduplicate identical engine histories by bytes but retain every source alias. Restore missing files from exact Raw_Evidence_Index archives and verify their manifests. Include later corrective population histories if referenced by the accepted Phase5 ledger.
conditioning.reader: auditor-side raw transactions only; no engine/executor/selector/scheduler imports
conditioning.counts: completed Model A hop or seat-content block = one; unfinished and non-Model-A = zero
conditioning.axis_ties: all maximizers, including all four for an empty history
conditioning.dcnh: formula sums separately from greatest axis-load cell; source attribution caveat retained

regression.requirement: every accepted method identity present and passing, plus any later accepted additions found at entry; no old 625 substitution
regression.legacy_preextension: Save frozen pre-extension checkpoints, audit outputs, and command/continuation expectations; verify restored bytes and outputs after implementation

tests: all eight positions and all sixteen types
one completed use changes exactly one count
no conditioning imports in engine modules

independence.price_auditor: Separate module using Model A type/position structure and literal CT price table; never calls executor price calculation.
independence.semantic_auditors: Existing ordinary audit chain with resource-model-aware raw accounting.
independence.standalone: Raw audit and conditioning run in a separate Python process without importing execution modules for evidence generation

efficiency.applicability: No optimization claim. Preserve exact semantic/history guards. Measure model comparison execution, checkpoint/restore and raw-audit costs on same completed ample workload; report actual samples without inventing a performance pass. Existing inactive-history guard 3/1 and unchanged-native guard 2/1 apply to matched legacy workload checks.
efficiency.workers: sequential isolated workers; 1 warmup and 3 measured repetitions for each declared paired core population model; timing separate from memory tracing

freeze: Hash all source, tests, contracts, evaluators and auditors before each acceptance run; any executed-file change invalidates that attempt; preserve failed/source-changed attempts.
safe_segments: 7.2 creation identity + shared payment hook (max 3 modules per segment)
7.2 independent auditing + resource stops (max 3 modules per segment)
7.4 ample panel then scarcity then package
